power_management_states.name: Run
power_management_states.description: Link in Run; data and NULLs/FCTs flowing.

power_management_states.name: NULL keep-alive
power_management_states.description: Link up but only NULL characters transmitted between data.

power_management_states.name: ErrorReset / disabled
power_management_states.description: Link disabled or reset; transmitter silent.

fields.wakeup_mechanism: A disabled or reset link re-runs the exchange handshake (ErrorReset -> ... -> Run) when enabled (Start) or on detected activity (AutoStart). LVDS low-power signalling keeps active-link power low.
fields.spacewire_power_considerations: LVDS signalling is chosen partly for low power and low EMI. The protocol-level power behavior is the AutoStart/Start enable and the NULL keep-alive idle; detailed rails and low-power SerDes behavior are physical-layer / implementation concerns.
fields.notes: SpaceWire's protocol-level power intent is the link enable (Start/AutoStart), the ErrorReset (transmitter silent) state, and the NULL keep-alive idle rather than a fine-grained power-domain spec. LVDS is inherently low-power; detailed rails are implementation concerns.

extraction_hints: Look for power-domain partitioning, supply nets.
